new:
GameEngine MUST NOT discover the base URL from an overlay vendor's API, address
format, or account model. ADR 0133 §4 states that no part of GameEngine depends
on a particular overlay, and a detection path would create that dependency in
the surface. The base is user-supplied because the hop is user-owned.

ADR 0167 amends that last rule only for an explicitly selected optional
machine-local publisher integration. The vendor-neutral/manual path remains
user-supplied, while an opted-in adapter may discover a private HTTPS origin
from its installed local client and reconcile only publication state it can
prove GameEngine owns. This does not permit implicit vendor probing, vendor
account/control-plane APIs, Funnel/public publication, or a vendor dependency in
the gateway, Agent Host, ACP, or MCP contracts.

Nothing in this section changes the gateway's binding. It binds to loopback, as
ADR 0133 §4 requires, before and after this record.
